decisions.reason: The DPA management tool sits close to the firm's compliance-focused offer for agencies, has its own page in both years and positive customer feedback, and the firm's in-house R&D lets it learn from early use and refine the tool.

The hosting management platform builds directly on the firm's core infrastructure and tooling know-how and stayed on the home page in both years, which marks it as a central offering the firm can keep developing.

The configurable managed hosting plan is close to the established business, has its own page in both years, and draws on existing technical service knowledge, so the firm can easily interpret its results and improve it.

Extended PHP security support builds on the firm's security and hosting expertise and fits its compliance direction, though its only brief mention so far and dependence on PHP version lifecycles leave it somewhat more likely to be folded into other offers.
